IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary.description: Lightweight timesheet summary for list displays and pagination results. Contains essential fields for identifying the work week, workflow status, total hours, and employee context without full detail or audit information.
IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Query erp_hrm_timesheets table with LEFT JOIN to erp_hrm_employees for employee context. Returns essential fields for timesheet list display: id, week_start_date, week_end_date, status, total_hours, submitted_at, reviewed_at, and employee relation. Excludes audit fields (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) and business-specific fields (rejection_reason, reviewerEmployee) not needed in summary views.

weekStartDate.description: Start date of the timesheet week, always a Monday. Must be Monday.
weekStartDate.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_timesheets.week_start_date. Validation: must be a Monday (ISO weekday = 1). This field defines the start of the timesheet week period.

weekEndDate.description: End date of the timesheet week, always a Sunday. Must be Sunday.
weekEndDate.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_timesheets.week_end_date. Validation: must be a Sunday (ISO weekday = 7). This field defines the end of the timesheet week period.

IErpHrmTimesheet.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating an existing timesheet record. Only week date boundaries can be modified. Status and rejection reason changes require separate workflow endpoints.
IErpHrmTimesheet.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Maps week_start_date and week_end_date fields from request body to erp_hrm_timesheets table. Validation: week_start_date must be Monday, week_end_date must be Sunday. week_start_date must be before or equal to week_end_date. Excluded fields: id (auto-generated, immutable), erp_hrm_employee_id (actor identity resolved from JWT), erp_hrm_reviewer_employee_id (system-assigned, immutable), status/rejection_reason (immutable via separate workflow endpoints), timestamps (auto-managed by system), total_hours (computed from timelogs), employee/reviewerEmployee (exposed via relation DTOs), timesheetTimelogs (managed via separate timelog endpoints).

addTimelogIds.description: Array of timelog UUIDs to add to the timesheet.
addTimelogIds.x-autobe-specification: Array of timelog UUIDs (erp_hrm_timelog_id values) to associate with the timesheet. Server creates junction records by INSERTing into erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs with these IDs and the path-parameter erp_hrm_timesheet_id. Validation: timelog must belong to the same employee as timesheet, timelog date must fall within timesheet week (Monday-Sunday), timelog not already associated.

removeTimelogIds.description: Array of timelog UUIDs to remove from the timesheet.
removeTimelogIds.x-autobe-specification: Array of timelog UUIDs (erp_hrm_timelog_id values) to disassociate from the timesheet. Server deletes junction records by DELETing from erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_timelog_id IN these IDs AND erp_hrm_timesheet_id = path param. Validation: timelog must currently be associated with this timesheet.

IErpHrmTimesheetTimelog.IUpdate.description: Request body for managing timelog associations on a draft timesheet. Contains arrays of timelog IDs to add to or remove from the timesheet.
IErpHrmTimesheetTimelog.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Junction table operation DTO for managing timesheet-timelog associations. addTimelogIds: array of timelog UUIDs to create junction records for (INSERT into erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs with erp_hrm_timelog_id and path-param erp_hrm_timesheet_id). removeTimelogIds: array of timelog UUIDs to delete junction records for (DELETE from erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_timelog_id IN removeTimelogIds AND erp_hrm_timesheet_id = path param). Both arrays optional per IUpdate pattern - server validates employee ownership and date range match. Database writes are server-computed operations based on these arrays.

erpHrmRoleId.description: Pre-assigned role for the invited employee. UUID reference to erp_hrm_roles.id.
erpHrmRoleId.x-autobe-specification: Maps to erp_hrm_role_id column. Request DTO FK pattern: scalar UUID string nullable. Backend validates role exists in same organization.

erpHrmDepartmentId.description: Pre-assigned department for the invited employee. UUID reference to erp_hrm_departments.id.
erpHrmDepartmentId.x-autobe-specification: Maps to erp_hrm_department_id column. Request DTO FK pattern: scalar UUID string nullable. Backend validates department exists in same organization.

position.x-autobe-specification: Maps to position column. Nullable string for optional job position.
position.description: Job position or title for the invited employee.

note.description: Optional message from the organization to the invited person. Can be updated to provide additional information or instructions.

expiresAt.description: New expiration timestamp for the invitation. Updating this effectively extends the invitation's validity period.

IErpHrmInvitation.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating an invitation. Allows modifying pre-assigned role and department, updating position or note, and extending expiration date. Only invitations in 'pending' status can be updated.
IErpHrmInvitation.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Maps optional fields to update: role_id, department_id (changeable associations), position, note, expires_at. All fields nullable/optional. Backend validates role/department exist in same organization. Path parameter invitationId provides invitation identity.

id.description: Unique identifier of the timesheet-timelog junction record.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.id.

addedAt.description: Timestamp when the timelog was added to the timesheet.

erpHrmTimelog.description: Complete timelog details including date, duration, description, billable flag, and resolved project/task associations.
erpHrmTimelog.x-autobe-specification: Join from erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.erp_hrm_timelog_id to erp_hrm_timelogs.id. Returns IErpHrmTimelog with all timelog fields and resolved employee/project/task summaries.

erpHrmEmployee.description: Employee who logged this time entry.
erpHrmEmployee.x-autobe-specification: Traverse erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.timelog relation to erp_hrm_timelogs.erp_hrm_employee_id, then JOIN to erp_hrm_employees.id. Returns IErpHrmEmployee.ISummary.

erpHrmProject.description: Project to which this time entry is associated.
erpHrmProject.x-autobe-specification: Traverse erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.timelog relation to erp_hrm_timelogs.erp_hrm_project_id, then JOIN to erp_hrm_projects.id. Returns IErpHrmProject.ISummary.

erpHrmTask.description: Optional task within the project that this time entry is logged against.
erpHrmTask.x-autobe-specification: Traverse erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.timelog relation to erp_hrm_timelogs.erp_hrm_task_id, then JOIN to erp_hrm_tasks.id. Returns IErpHrmTask.ISummary or null when task_id is null.

erpHrmTimesheet.description: Parent timesheet context showing which weekly timesheet contains this timelog entry.
erpHrmTimesheet.x-autobe-specification: Join from erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs.erp_hrm_timesheet_id to erp_hrm_timesheets.id. Returns IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary only (partial view) to prevent circular reference in JSON serialization.

IErpHrmTimesheetTimelog.IInvert.description: Inverted response for timesheet-timelog junction showing the complete timelog entry with its parent timesheet context. Used by GET endpoints to return timelog details without circular reference issues.
IErpHrmTimesheetTimelog.IInvert.x-autobe-specification: Query erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs junction table. Direct columns: id, added_at. Belongs-to relations via JOINs: timelog (full IErpHrmTimelog), timesheet (IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary only to prevent circular reference). erpHrmEmployee, erpHrmProject, erpHrmTask are computed from the nested timelog object.

oneOf.description: Discriminator field indicating the type of session. Determines which fields are present in the response.
Discriminator field indicating the type of session. Determines which fields are present in the response.
Discriminator field indicating the type of session. Determines which fields are present in the response.

session_type.description: Discriminator field indicating the type of session: member, admin, or guest.
session_type.x-autobe-specification: Discriminator indicating which session table this record originated from: 'member' for erp_hrm_member_sessions, 'admin' for erp_hrm_admin_sessions, 'guest' for erp_hrm_guests. Determined at query time based on which table contains the session record.

id.description: Unique identifier of the session.
id.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from id column in the source session table: erp_hrm_member_sessions.id, erp_hrm_admin_sessions.id, or erp_hrm_guest_sessions.id depending on session_type value.

ip.description: Client IP address from the login request.
ip.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from ip column in erp_hrm_member_sessions, erp_hrm_admin_sessions, or erp_hrm_guest_sessions. Captured at session creation time from login request.

href.description: Request URL when the session was created.
href.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from href column in erp_hrm_member_sessions, erp_hrm_admin_sessions, or erp_hrm_guest_sessions. Records the request URL at session creation.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header from the login request.
referrer.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from referrer column in erp_hrm_member_sessions, erp_hrm_admin_sessions, or erp_hrm_guest_sessions. HTTP referrer header from login request.

created_at.description: Session creation timestamp.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from created_at column in erp_hrm_member_sessions, erp_hrm_admin_sessions, or erp_hrm_guest_sessions. Timestamp when session was created.

expired_at.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from expired_at column in erp_hrm_member_sessions, erp_hrm_admin_sessions, or erp_hrm_guest_sessions. Timestamp when session expires.

member.description: Associated member entity summary (present only for member sessions).
member.x-autobe-specification: When session_type is 'member', JOIN erp_hrm_member_sessions.erp_hrm_member_id to erp_hrm_members.id. Returns IErpHrmMember.ISummary. Only populated when session_type equals 'member'.

admin.description: Associated admin entity summary (present only for admin sessions).
admin.x-autobe-specification: When session_type is 'admin', JOIN erp_hrm_admin_sessions.admin_id to erp_hrm_admins.id. Returns IErpHrmAdmin.ISummary. Only populated when session_type equals 'admin'.

guest.description: Associated guest entity summary (present only for guest sessions).
guest.x-autobe-specification: When session_type is 'guest', JOIN erp_hrm_guest_sessions.guest_id to erp_hrm_guests.id. Returns IErpHrmGuest.ISummary. Only populated when session_type equals 'guest'.

access_token.description: JWT access token for authenticated API requests (member sessions only).
access_token.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from access_token column in erp_hrm_member_sessions. JWT access token for authenticated API requests. Only present when session_type equals 'member'.

refresh_token.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens (member sessions only).
refresh_token.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from refresh_token column in erp_hrm_member_sessions. JWT refresh token for renewing access tokens. Only present when session_type equals 'member'.

token_expired_at.description: Access token expiration timestamp (member sessions only).
token_expired_at.x-autobe-specification: Mapped from token_expired_at column in erp_hrm_member_sessions. Timestamp when the access token expires. Only present when session_type equals 'member'.

IErpHrmMemberSession.description: Unified session entity representing member, admin, or guest sessions with session metadata, entity context, and authentication tokens.
IErpHrmMemberSession.x-autobe-specification: Polymorphic union of three session tables: erp_hrm_member_sessions, erp_hrm_admin_sessions, erp_hrm_guest_sessions. Implementation: 1) Query session by ID from all three tables, 2) Identify session_type from which table found, 3) JOIN with corresponding entity table to populate relation fields, 4) Include token fields only for member sessions. The discriminator field session_type determines which relation field is populated.

billable.description: Filter for billable status. When true, only billable time entries are included. When false, only non-billable entries. When null, all entries regardless of billable status.

employee_id.x-autobe-specification: Optional filter for specific employee. When set, the report includes time entries only for this employee.
employee_id.description: Optional filter for specific employee. When set, the report includes time entries only for this employee. Must belong to the same organization as the report.

end_date.description: End date of the report date range filter. Time entries up to and including this date are included in the report.

group_by.description: Grouping preference for the report output. Determines how time entries are aggregated: by employee, by project, or by task.

project_id.x-autobe-specification: Optional filter for specific project. When set, the report includes time entries only for this project.
project_id.description: Optional filter for specific project. When set, the report includes time entries only for this project. Must belong to the same organization as the report.

start_date.description: Start date of the report date range filter. Time entries from this date onwards are included in the report.

task_id.x-autobe-specification: Optional filter for specific task. When set, the report includes time entries only for this task.
task_id.description: Optional filter for specific task. When set, the report includes time entries only for this task. Must belong to a project in the same organization as the report.

IErpHrmReportParameter.ICreate.description: Request body for creating report filter parameters. Used when generating a new report to specify the date range, entity filters, and grouping preferences. Part of the atomic report creation process.
IErpHrmReportParameter.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps filter parameters for report generation. Required fields: start_date, end_date (date range), group_by (aggregation preference). Optional filters: employee_id, project_id, task_id (entity filters), billable (billable status filter). Excluded: id (auto), erp_hrm_report_id (from parent relation), timestamps (auto).

id.description: Unique identifier for the organization.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_organizations.id. UUID primary key.

name.description: Organization display name shown throughout the application.

description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_organizations.description. Nullable field.

logoUri.description: URL to the organization's logo image.
logoUri.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_organizations.logo_uri. Nullable field. camelCase conversion.

currency.description: Organization's primary currency code for billing and reports (e.g., USD, EUR, KRW).

timezone.description: Organization's timezone for time tracking and scheduling (e.g., Asia/Seoul, America/New_York).

fiscalStartMonth.description: Month (1-12) when the organization's fiscal year starts.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_organizations.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format.

owner.description: The owner member who has full administrative control over the organization.
owner.x-autobe-specification: Join from erp_hrm_organizations.owner_id to erp_hrm_members.id. Returns IErpHrmMember.ISummary as BELONGS-TO relation.

IErpHrmOrganization.ISummary.description: Lightweight organization summary for list displays and parent context in nested structures. Contains essential organization identity and configuration: id, name, description, logo, currency settings, timezone, and fiscal year start month. Includes owner reference as BELONGS-TO relation. Excludes HAS-MANY compositions for lightweight response.
IErpHrmOrganization.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Query erp_hrm_organizations table. Select: id, name, description, logo_uri, currency, timezone, fiscal_start_month, created_at. JOIN erp_hrm_members for owner (BELONGS-TO) returning IErpHrmMember.ISummary. ISummary excludes HAS-MANY compositions (departments, employees, roles, projects, invitations, reports, activityLogs) and updated_at for lightweight response.

organization.description: Basic organization information with employee count. Contains the organization's id, name, total active employee count, currency code for billing/reporting, and timezone for time tracking calculations.

employee_count.description: Total number of active employees in the organization

organization.x-autobe-specification: COMPUTED FROM: erp_hrm_organizations.id, erp_hrm_organizations.name, erp_hrm_organizations.currency, erp_hrm_organizations.timezone, COUNT(erp_hrm_employees) WHERE erp_hrm_employees.deleted_at IS NULL. Joins erp_hrm_employees to count active employees belonging to this organization.

employeeStatistics.description: Employee distribution statistics by status and employment type. Shows total employee count and breakdowns by employment status (active/deactivated) and classification (full-time, part-time, contractor, intern).

total_count.description: Total number of employee records including deactivated

by_status.description: Employee counts grouped by employment status

active.description: Number of employees with active status

deactivated.description: Number of employees with deactivated status

by_employment_type.description: Employee counts grouped by employment classification

employeeStatistics.x-autobe-specification: COMPUTED FROM: erp_hrm_employees WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId. Aggregates: COUNT(*) for total_count, COUNT(*) GROUP BY status (active/deactivated) for by_status, COUNT(*) GROUP BY employment_type (full_time/part_time/contractor/intern) for by_employment_type.

projectOverview.description: Project distribution and budget utilization metrics. Shows total project count, breakdown by status (active/archived/completed), total budget hours allocated, hours actually utilized, and percentage of budget consumed.

total_count.description: Total number of projects in the organization

by_status.description: Project counts grouped by lifecycle status

active.description: Number of active projects accepting timelogs

total_budget_hours.description: Sum of budget_hours across all projects with budgets set

utilized_budget_hours.description: Sum of actual hours logged against project budgets

budget_utilization_percentage.description: Percentage of total budget hours that have been utilized

projectOverview.x-autobe-specification: COMPUTED FROM: erp_hrm_projects WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId. Aggregates: COUNT(*) GROUP BY status (active/archived/completed) for by_status; SUM(budget_hours) WHERE budget_hours IS NOT NULL for total_budget_hours; SUM of actual hours from erp_hrm_timelogs joined via erp_hrm_projects for utilized_budget_hours; Calculate (utilized_budget_hours / total_budget_hours * 100) for budget_utilization_percentage.

taskMetrics.description: Task statistics grouped by status and priority with completion metrics. Shows total task count, breakdown by workflow status (open/in-progress/completed/closed), priority levels (low/medium/high/urgent), and the overall completion rate percentage.

total_count.description: Total number of tasks across all projects

by_status.description: Task counts grouped by workflow status

open.description: Number of tasks in open status

in_progress.description: Number of tasks currently in progress

by_priority.description: Task counts grouped by priority level

completion_rate.description: Percentage of tasks that are completed (completed / total tasks * 100)

taskMetrics.x-autobe-specification: COMPUTED FROM: erp_hrm_tasks WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM erp_hrm_projects WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId). Aggregates: COUNT(*) for total_count, COUNT(*) GROUP BY status (open/in_progress/completed/closed) for by_status, COUNT(*) GROUP BY priority (low/medium/high/urgent) for by_priority. completion_rate = (completed / total_count) * 100.

timeTracking.description: Aggregated time tracking data including billable breakdown. Shows hours logged this week and month, billable vs non-billable hour totals, and average daily hours worked based on the organization's timezone.

hours_logged_this_week.description: Total hours logged during the current week based on org timezone

hours_logged_this_month.description: Total hours logged during the current month based on org timezone

billable_hours.description: Total billable hours logged this month

non_billable_hours.description: Total non-billable hours logged this month

average_daily_hours.description: Average hours logged per day this month

timeTracking.x-autobe-specification: COMPUTED FROM: erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId AND started_at falls within current week/month (using org timezone). hours_logged = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60. hours_logged_this_week/month = SUM WHERE started_at in respective period. billable_hours = SUM WHERE billable = true. non_billable_hours = SUM WHERE billable = false. average_daily_hours = hours_logged_this_month / number_of_days_in_month.

recentActivity.description: Latest 10 significant actions performed within the organization. Contains an array of activity log summaries showing who performed each action, what action occurred, what entity was affected, and when it happened.
recentActivity.x-autobe-specification: COMPUTED FROM: erp_hrm_activity_logs WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10. Returns array of IErpHrmActivityLog.ISummary objects with member join for displaying actor information.

IErpHrmOrganization.description: Comprehensive organization dashboard containing aggregate metrics across employees, projects, tasks, time tracking, and recent activity. Provides administrators and managers with a quick overview of organizational performance and health. This schema is used by GET /erpHrm/admin/organizations/{organizationId}/dashboard and GET /erpHrm/member/organizations/{organizationId}/dashboard endpoints.
IErpHrmOrganization.x-autobe-specification:
COMPUTED AGGREGATION SCHEMA - Data sourced from multiple tables via aggregation queries:

1. Organization Summary: JOIN erp_hrm_organizations with COUNT(erp_hrm_employees) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
2. Employee Statistics: COUNT FROM erp_hrm_employees WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId GROUP BY status, employment_type
3. Project Statistics: COUNT FROM erp_hrm_projects WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId GROUP BY status; SUM(budget_hours) WHERE budget_hours IS NOT NULL; SUM actual hours from erp_hrm_timelogs joined with erp_hrm_projects for utilization
4. Task Metrics: COUNT FROM erp_hrm_tasks WHERE project_id IN (SELECT id FROM erp_hrm_projects WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId) GROUP BY status, priority; Calculate completion_rate = completed / total * 100
5. Time Tracking: SUM(duration_minutes)/60 FROM erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId for current week/month (date range based on org timezone); GROUP BY billable flag
6. Recent Activity: SELECT TOP 10 FROM erp_hrm_activity_logs WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId ORDER BY created_at DESC

scenario.draft:
Test creating a new guest session with valid device_id (UUID format) and session context metadata.

Steps:
1. Send POST request with valid deviceId (UUID v4 format), href (current page URL), referrer (referring page URL), and optional ip address.
2. Validate response returns HTTP 201 with IErpHrmGuest.IAuthorized structure.
3. Verify response contains: id (UUID), device_identifier (matches input), token object with access/refresh/expired_at/refreshable_until fields.
4. Confirm JWT tokens are valid format (non-empty strings).
5. Verify expired_at is in the future and refreshable_until extends beyond expiration.
6. Validate created_at and updated_at timestamps are present and valid ISO 8601 format.
7. Assert deleted_at is null (newly created guest is active).
8. Verify temporaryEmail can be optionally included and stored in session context.

dependencies.purpose:
Essential authentication prerequisite:
This join operation (post /erpHrm/auth/guest/join) must be executed before any operations requiring 'guest' actor authorization.
It establishes the necessary user account and authentication context for the 'guest' actor, enabling subsequent API calls that depend on this specific authorization level.
Without this join operation, the main scenario endpoint and its dependencies will fail due to insufficient authentication credentials.

functions.name: test_api_guest_session_creation_with_valid_device

scenario.draft:
Test that using the same device_id returns the existing guest session instead of creating a duplicate.

Steps:
1. First request: Create a guest session with a specific device_id and capture the returned session id.
2. Second request: Send another join request with the identical device_id.
3. Validate second response returns HTTP 200 (or 201) with the same guest session id from step 1.
4. Verify device_identifier matches the original device_id.
5. Confirm new JWT tokens are generated (access and refresh tokens are new, not the same as first request).
6. Validate session persistence - system should not create duplicate guest records for same device.

scenario.draft:
Test guest session creation with optional temporary_email field and verify token structure.

Steps:
1. Create guest session with device_id, href, referrer, and include a valid temporaryEmail address.
2. Validate response includes all required fields: id, device_identifier, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (null), and token.
3. Verify token.access is a valid JWT format string.
4. Verify token.refresh is a valid token string.
5. Confirm token.expired_at timestamp is in the future (within expected access token lifetime, typically 15-60 minutes).
6. Confirm token.refreshable_until is significantly later than expired_at (typically 7-30 days for guest sessions).
7. Validate email format is correctly captured when provided.
8. Verify the guest can use the returned access token for subsequent authenticated requests (if endpoint available).

# 비즈니스 로직 구현

**테스트 단계가 완료**되었습니다. 이제 Realize 에이전트를 실행하여 모든 API 서비스提供商(providers)를 구현하겠습니다.

contents.text: Don't ask me to do that, and just do it right now.

authorizations.error_analysis: The compile error shown is in src/MyGlobal.ts (line 286) which is a pre-existing system file importing './MyConfiguration'. This is NOT an error in the generated authorization components (guestAuthorize, GuestAuth, GuestPayload). The generated components have correct import paths and TypeScript syntax.
authorizations.solution_guidance: The MyGlobal.ts import error is a pre-existing infrastructure issue outside the authorization components. The generated guestAuthorize provider correctly imports jwtAuthorize from './jwtAuthorize', GuestPayload from the correct payload path, and uses proper Prisma query patterns with soft-delete (deleted_at: null) and session expiration checks (expired_at: { gt: new Date() }). No corrections needed for the authorization components themselves.

provider.name: guestAuthorize

decorator.name: GuestAuth

payload.name: GuestPayload

actor.name: guest
actor.description: Unauthenticated users who can sign up or log in to access the system

authorizations.error_analysis: The compilation errors are caused by incorrect import paths in the authorization components. The provider imports MyGlobal from '../../../MyGlobal' instead of '../../MyGlobal'. Additionally, the compile error in src/MyGlobal.ts is a prerequisite issue - MyGlobal.ts is trying to import './MyConfiguration' which does not exist. The authorization components themselves are correctly structured but cannot compile until MyGlobal.ts is fixed.
authorizations.solution_guidance: 1. Fixed import path in provider: Changed from '../../../MyGlobal' to '../../MyGlobal' (2 levels up from src/providers/authorize/) - 2. The error in src/MyGlobal.ts (Cannot find module './MyConfiguration') is a prerequisite file issue that must be fixed separately - MyGlobal.ts is trying to import a non-existent module './MyConfiguration'. This is not an authorization component error but a project dependency that must be resolved for the authorization components to work.

provider.name: memberAuthorize

decorator.name: MemberAuth

payload.name: MemberPayload

actor.name: member
actor.description: Authenticated users who work within an organization context, including employees, managers, and owners

authorizations.error_analysis:
Single compilation error found:

1. **MyGlobal.ts (line 286)**: Cannot find module './MyConfiguration' or its corresponding type declarations.

This error indicates that MyGlobal.ts imports from a file called 'MyConfiguration' which does not exist in the project. This is a missing dependency issue that prevents the Prisma client wrapper (MyGlobal) from compiling, which in turn breaks all authorization components that depend on it.

plan.thinking: IErpHrmReport.ICreate is a Create DTO for generating reports. Maps to erp_hrm_reports table with nested erp_hrm_report_parameters (atomic composition). Collectable: true.

IErpHrmTimelog.ICreate is a Create DTO for POST /erpHrm/member/timelogs endpoint. Maps directly to erp_hrm_timelogs table with columns: project_id, task_id (optional), date, duration_minutes, description (optional), billable. The erp_hrm_employee_id foreign key is NOT in the DTO body - it is derived from the authenticated member's employee record in the current organization context. Collectable.

IErpHrmRole.ICreate is a Create DTO for creating custom roles. Maps to erp_hrm_roles table. Permissions are stored via erp_hrm_role_permissions junction table. Organization ID is resolved from JWT session (authorized actor), not from path parameters. Collectable with external reference to erp_hrm_organizations from authorized actor.

IErpHrmDepartment.ICreate is a Create DTO that maps directly to erp_hrm_departments table. The Create DTO contains name (required), description (optional), and parent_id (optional for one-level hierarchy). The erp_hrm_organization_id is not in the DTO body - it comes from the authenticated session's organization context. Collectable with reference to organization from authorized session.

IErpHrmContract.ICreate is a Create DTO for employee contracts. Maps to erp_hrm_contracts table. The employee reference (erp_hrm_employee_id) comes from path parameter employeeId, not in DTO body. Collectable.

IErpHrmProjectMember.ICreate maps to erp_hrm_projects table. Collectable. The DTO contains project properties (name, description, color, status, budget_hours, dates) but the erp_hrm_organization_id FK comes from the authenticated session context, not from the DTO body.

IErpHrmTask.ICreate is a Create DTO used for creating tasks via POST /projects/{projectId}/tasks. It maps to erp_hrm_tasks table (confirmed by x-autobe-database-schema). The projectId path parameter provides the erp_hrm_project_id foreign key reference. Collectable with project reference from path.

IErpHrmTimesheet.ICreate is a Create DTO for creating draft timesheets. Maps to erp_hrm_timesheets table with week_start_date and week_end_date fields. Employee ID is extracted from JWT session (authorized actor), not provided in request body. Collectable with employee reference from authorized session context.

IErpHrmTimer.ICreate is a Create DTO for starting timer sessions. Maps to erp_hrm_timers table. Contains erp_hrm_project_id (required) and erp_hrm_task_id (optional), but erp_hrm_employee_id FK is NOT in the DTO body - it comes from the authenticated session actor. Collectable with external reference to erp_hrm_employees from authorized actor.

IErpHrmInvitation.ICreate is a Create DTO that maps to erp_hrm_invitations table. Collectable. The organization context comes from the authorized session (JWT), not from path parameters. No other external references needed - role_id and department_id are optional fields within the request body.

IErpHrmReportParameter.ICreate is a Create DTO that maps directly to erp_hrm_report_parameters table. Contains all filter parameters (start_date, end_date, group_by, optional employee_id/project_id/task_id, billable) in the request body. The erp_hrm_report_id foreign key is provided by the parent report context in the service layer. Collectable.

IErpHrmReportParameter is a read DTO that maps to erp_hrm_report_parameters table. The schema shows x-autobe-database-schema: erp_hrm_report_parameters with direct field mappings (id, start_date, end_date, group_by, billable, created_at, updated_at) and BELONGS-TO relations (report, employee, project, task). Transformable.

IErpHrmReport is a complete report entity with x-autobe-database-schema: erp_hrm_reports. Maps directly to the reports table with BELONGS-TO relations (organization, generatedByMember) and HAS-ONE (parameter). Transformable.

IErpHrmDepartment.ISummary is a lightweight department entity for list displays and parent context in nested structures. The schema specification shows it queries erp_hrm_departments table with SELECT on id, name, description, parent_id, created_at, updated_at and JOIN for parent department summary. This is a read DTO used for API responses with direct database mapping. Transformable.

IErpHrmProjectMember is a complete project entity DTO that maps directly to the erp_hrm_projects database table. It contains direct fields from erp_hrm_projects (id, name, description, color, status, budget_hours, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at), BELONGS-TO relation to organization, and HAS-MANY compositions. This is a transformable Read DTO used for API responses.
IErpHrmTimesheetTimelog.IInvert maps to erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs junction table with nested timelog, employee, project, task, and timesheet relations. Transformable.

IErpHrmTimesheet is a complete entity DTO for timesheet responses. Maps directly to erp_hrm_timesheets table with nested employee, reviewerEmployee (BELONGS-TO), and timesheetTimelogs (HAS_MANY). Used for GET responses and return types. Transformable.

IErpHrmTask is a complete task entity used for API responses. Based on x-autobe-database-schema: erp_hrm_tasks annotation, it maps directly to the erp_hrm_tasks database table. It contains direct fields (id, title, description, status, priority, estimated_hours, due_date, created_at, updated_at) and BELONGS-TO relations (project, assignee) plus HAS-MANY relations (subtasks, taskHistories, timelogs, timers). Transformable.

IErpHrmAdmin.ISummary maps to erp_hrm_admins table. It is a read DTO for list display, directly backed by the database, with direct field mapping (id, email, display_name, avatar_uri, phone, created_at, updated_at). No JOINs required for ISummary variant. Transformable.

IErpHrmAdmin maps to erp_hrm_admins table. This is a Read DTO used for API responses containing admin account data (id, email, display_name, avatar_uri, phone, created_at, updated_at). All properties have direct mappings to database columns. Password hash is excluded for security. Transformable - transformer will be generated.

IErpHrmGuestSession.ISummary is a summary DTO for guest session list displays. The interface schema contains x-autobe-database-schema: erp_hrm_guest_sessions, confirming direct mapping to the guest_sessions table. It includes a JOIN to erp_hrm_guests for device information but the primary table is erp_hrm_guest_sessions. Transformable.

IErpHrmAdminAuditLog.ISummary is a read DTO for admin audit log entries used in list displays. It maps directly to erp_hrm_admin_audit_logs table with BELONGS-TO join to erp_hrm_admins for the admin summary field. All properties are direct mappings from the database table with proper x-autobe-database-schema annotations. Transformable.

IErpHrmGuest.ISummary maps to erp_hrm_guests table with sessions_count aggregation. This is a Read DTO used for paginated guest lists, DB-backed from erp_hrm_guests with JOIN to erp_hrm_guest_sessions for session count. Transformable.
IErpHrmAdminSession.ISummary is a read DTO for listing admin sessions. Maps directly to erp_hrm_admin_sessions table with BELONGS-TO relation to erp_hrm_admins for admin context. Transformable.
IErpHrmGuest maps to erp_hrm_guests with all properties as direct column mappings (id, device_identifier, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). No JOINs, no computed fields. Transformable.

IErpHrmAdminAuditLog is a complete admin audit log entity returned by GET /erpHrm/admin/admin-audit-logs/{auditLogId}. It maps directly to erp_hrm_admin_audit_logs database table with BELONGS-TO relation to erp_hrm_admins (admin summary). This is a transformable DTO because it is a read DTO used for API responses, database-backed with direct mapping to a single primary table, and contains direct columns (id, action_type, target_entity, target_id, metadata, ip_address, created_at) plus nested admin relation. Transformer will be generated.

import { TypedBody, TypedParam, TypedRoute } from "@nestia/core";
import { Controller } from "@nestjs/common";
import typia, { tags } from "typia";

import { IErpHrmTimesheet } from "../../../../api/structures/IErpHrmTimesheet";
import { IPageIErpHrmTimesheet } from "../../../../api/structures/IPageIErpHrmTimesheet";
import { MemberAuth } from "../../../../decorators/MemberAuth";
import { MemberPayload } from "../../../../decorators/payload/MemberPayload";
import { deleteErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetId } from "../../../../providers/deleteErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetId";
import { getErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetId } from "../../../../providers/getErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetId";
import { patchErpHrmMemberTimesheets } from "../../../../providers/patchErpHrmMemberTimesheets";
import { postErpHrmMemberTimesheets } from "../../../../providers/postErpHrmMemberTimesheets";
import { postErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetIdApprove } from "../../../../providers/postErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetIdApprove";
import { postErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetIdReject } from "../../../../providers/postErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetIdReject";
import { postErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetIdSubmit } from "../../../../providers/postErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetIdSubmit";
import { putErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetId } from "../../../../providers/putErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetId";

@Controller("/erpHrm/member/timesheets")
export class ErphrmMemberTimesheetsController {
  /**
   * Create a new draft timesheet for the authenticated employee covering a specific work week.
   *
   * This endpoint creates a draft timesheet for the employee identified by the current session. The timesheet represents a work week from Monday to Sunday. When created, the system automatically includes all timelogs belonging to the employee that fall within the specified week date range.
   *
   * The created timesheet starts in draft status, allowing the employee to add or remove timelogs before submission. The total hours are calculated from all included timelogs. Only one timesheet can exist per employee per week (enforced by unique constraint on employee_id and week_start_date).
   *
   * Employees can create multiple draft timesheets for different weeks. The week_start_date must always be a Monday and week_end_date must always be the following Sunday of the same week.
   *
   * Security: Only authenticated members within an organization context can create timesheets. The employee ID is derived from the session, not provided in the request body. Users with time:approve permission cannot create timesheets on behalf of others through this endpoint.
   *
   * Related operations:
   * - GET /timesheets/{timesheetId} - Retrieve timesheet details including included timelogs
   * - PATCH /timesheets - List and filter timesheets with pagination
   * - PUT /timesheets/{timesheetId} - Submit timesheet for approval
   * - DELETE /timesheets/{timesheetId} - Cancel/delete a draft timesheet
   *
   * @param connection
   * @param body Week date range for the timesheet to be created
   * @x-autobe-authorization-type null
   * @x-autobe-authorization-actor member
   * @x-autobe-specification Create a new draft timesheet for the authenticated employee.
   *
   * 1. Extract employee ID from the authenticated session (verified member in organization context).
   *
   * 2. Validate request body:
   *    - week_start_date: Required, must be a Monday (ISO weekday = 1)
   *    - week_end_date: Required, must be a Sunday (ISO weekday = 7), must be exactly 6 days after week_start_date
   *    - Calculate and store total_hours as 0 initially
   *    - Set status to 'draft'
   *
   * 3. Check for duplicate:
   *    - Query erp_hrm_timesheets table for existing record with same erp_hrm_employee_id AND week_start_date
   *    - If exists with status 'submitted' or 'approved', return conflict error
   *    - If exists with status 'draft' or 'rejected', return the existing draft (or allow overwrite - business decision)
   *
   * 4. Create timesheet record in erp_hrm_timesheets with:
   *    - id: Generated UUID
   *    - erp_hrm_employee_id: From session
   *    - week_start_date: From request
   *    - week_end_date: From request
   *    - status: 'draft'
   *    - total_hours: 0
   *    - submitted_at: null
   *    - reviewed_at: null
   *    - rejection_reason: null
   *    - created_at: Current timestamp
   *    - updated_at: Current timestamp
   *    - deleted_at: null
   *
   * 5. Auto-include timelogs:
   *    - Query erp_hrm_timelogs for all timelogs where:
   *      - erp_hrm_employee_id matches session employee
   *      - log_date >= week_start_date AND log_date <= week_end_date
   *      - NOT already linked to another timesheet
   *      - NOT locked (locked = false)
   *    - Create junction records in erp_hrm_timesheet_timelogs linking each timelog to new timesheet
   *    - Recalculate total_hours from included timelogs (SUM of duration)
   *
   * 6. Return the created timesheet with:
   *    - All basic fields
   *    - Included timelogs array (with details)
   *    - Calculated total_hours
   *    - Employee summary information
   *
   * Error handling:
   * - 400: Invalid date format or dates not Monday-Sunday
   * - 401: Not authenticated
   * - 403: Not a member of any organization
   * - 409: Timesheet already exists for this week
   * @nestia Generated by Nestia - https://github.com/samchon/nestia
   */
  @TypedRoute.Post()
  public async create(
    @MemberAuth()
    member: MemberPayload,
    @TypedBody()
    body: IErpHrmTimesheet.ICreate,
  ): Promise<IErpHrmTimesheet> {
    try {
      return await postErpHrmMemberTimesheets({
        member,
        body,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Retrieve a filtered and paginated list of timesheets within the organization.
   *
   * This operation provides advanced search capabilities for timesheets including filtering by workflow status (draft, submitted, approved, rejected), date range coverage, and employee ownership. The results are returned in a paginated format optimized for list displays.
   *
   * **Permission-Based Filtering**:
   *
   * When invoked by a member without time:approve permission, the operation automatically scopes results to timesheets owned by the authenticated employee. This ensures data isolation between employees.
   *
   * When invoked by a user with time:approve permission (typically managers or organization owners), the operation returns all timesheets within the organization regardless of ownership, allowing reviewers to access the approval queue.
   *
   * **Relationship to Database Schema**:
   *
   * This operation queries the erp_hrm_timesheets table which stores weekly timesheets with status tracking, week date boundaries (Monday-Sunday), total hours calculated from included timelogs, and reviewer information. The table enforces a composite unique constraint on employee_id and week_start_date to prevent duplicate timesheets for the same employee and week.
   *
   * **Usage Context**:
   *
   * Employees use this endpoint to view their own timesheet history and track submission status. Reviewers use this endpoint to access submitted timesheets awaiting approval. The response includes summary information optimized for list displays including status, total hours, and week date range.
   *
   * **Filtering Options**:
   *
   * Supports filtering by timesheet status (draft, submitted, approved, rejected), date range covering the week_start_date, and optionally by specific employee for authorized reviewers. Sorting options include creation date and week start date.
   *
   * @param connection
   * @param body Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering timesheets
   * @x-autobe-authorization-type null
   * @x-autobe-authorization-actor member
   * @x-autobe-specification Query erp_hrm_timesheets table within the current organization context with the following implementation:
   *
   * 1. **Base Query**: Start with SELECT query on erp_hrm_timesheets filtered by organization context (via employee relationship)
   *
   * 2. **Authorization Filtering**:
   *    - If member lacks time:approve permission: Add WHERE clause filtering by erp_hrm_employee_id matching the authenticated user's employee record
   *    - If member has time:approve permission: Return all timesheets within the organization
   *
   * 3. **Search Criteria from Request Body** (apply all provided filters):
   *    - status: Filter by timesheet status field (draft, submitted, approved, rejected)
   *    - weekStartDateFrom/weekStartDateTo: Filter by week_start_date range
   *    - employeeId: Filter by erp_hrm_employee_id (only allowed for time:approve permission holders)
   *
   * 4. **Pagination**: Apply cursor-based or offset pagination using page/pageSize parameters
   *    - Default page size: 20
   *    - Maximum page size: 100
   *
   * 5. **Sorting**: Order by created_at DESC by default, optionally by week_start_date DESC
   *
   * 6. **Include Related Data**: Join with erp_hrm_employees to include employee name/email for reviewer views
   *
   * 7. **Response Construction**: Map results to IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary format with essential fields:
   *    - id, weekStartDate, weekEndDate, status, totalHours, submittedAt, reviewedAt
   *    - Include employee summary info when viewing all timesheets
   *
   * 8. **Edge Cases**:
   *    - Empty result set returns empty pagination array
   *    - Invalid date ranges return validation error
   *    - Unauthorized employeeId filter attempts are silently ignored (not rejected) for members
   * @nestia Generated by Nestia - https://github.com/samchon/nestia
   */
  @TypedRoute.Patch()
  public async index(
    @MemberAuth()
    member: MemberPayload,
    @TypedBody()
    body: IErpHrmTimesheet.IRequest,
  ): Promise<IPageIErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary> {
    try {
      return await patchErpHrmMemberTimesheets({
        member,
        body,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Retrieve a specific timesheet by its unique identifier.
   *
   * This endpoint retrieves the complete details of a single timesheet, including its associated employee information, week date range, current workflow status, total hours calculated from included timelogs, submission timestamp, and review information if the timesheet has been approved or rejected.
   *
   * The timesheet must belong to the current organization context. Employees can only retrieve their own timesheets unless they possess the time:view_all permission, which grants the ability to view any employee's timesheets within the organization. Users with time:view_all permission can see timesheets in all states including draft, submitted, approved, and rejected.
   *
   * The response includes all timelog associations for the timesheet. When the timesheet status is approved, all included timelogs are locked from editing. When the status is rejected, the rejection_reason field contains the mandatory reason provided by the reviewer.
   *
   * For employees without time:view_all permission, attempting to access another employee's timesheet returns an access denied response. The system does not reveal whether a timesheet exists to unauthorized users.
   *
   * Related operations:
   * - PATCH /timesheets for listing timesheets with filters
   * - POST /timesheets for creating new draft timesheets
   * - PUT /timesheets/{timesheetId}/submit for submitting a draft timesheet
   * - PUT /timesheets/{timesheetId}/approve and /reject for the approval workflow
   *
   * @param connection
   * @param timesheetId Unique identifier of the timesheet to retrieve (UUID format)
   * @x-autobe-authorization-type null
   * @x-autobe-authorization-actor member
   * @x-autobe-specification Service Layer:
   * 1. Extract timesheetId from path parameters, validate as UUID format
   * 2. Query erp_hrm_timesheets table by id with soft-delete filter (deleted_at IS NULL)
   * 3. Verify organization context matches the timesheet's organization via employee relationship
   * 4. Authorization check:
   *    - If requester has time:view_all permission → allow access to any timesheet
   *    - Otherwise → verify timesheet.erp_hrm_employee_id matches current user's employee record
   * 5. If timesheet not found or unauthorized → return appropriate error response
   * 6. Load associated employee details for the timesheet owner
   * 7. Load reviewer employee details if reviewer_employee_id is not null
   * 8. Return complete timesheet with related employee and reviewer information
   *
   * Edge Cases:
   * - Invalid UUID format → 400 Bad Request
   * - Timesheet soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) → 404 Not Found
   * - Timesheet not found → 404 Not Found
   * - Unauthorized access attempt → 403 Forbidden (do not reveal existence)
   * @nestia Generated by Nestia - https://github.com/samchon/nestia
   */
  @TypedRoute.Get(":timesheetId")
  public async at(
    @MemberAuth()
    member: MemberPayload,
    @TypedParam("timesheetId")
    timesheetId: string & tags.Format<"uuid">,
  ): Promise<IErpHrmTimesheet> {
    try {
      return await getErpHrmMemberTimesheetsTimesheetId({
        member,
        timesheetId,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update an existing timesheet record to modify its properties.
   *
   * This operation allows modification of timesheet fields for employees working with their own draft timesheets. Only timesheets in draft status can be updated by the owning employee. Users with time:manage permission can update any timesheet regardless of status or ownership.
   *
   * The timesheet entity contains employee ownership (erp_hrm_employee_id), reviewer tracking (erp_hrm_reviewer_employee_id), week date boundaries (week_start_date must be Monday, week_end_date must be Sunday), workflow status, calculated total hours from included timelogs, submission and review timestamps, and optional rejection reason for rejected timesheets.
   *
   * Attempting to update a submitted or approved timesheet without time:manage permission returns an access denied error. The system validates that status transitions follow the defined workflow rules.
   *
   * @param connection
   * @param timesheetId Unique identifier of the timesheet to update
   * @param body Timesheet update payload containing fields to modify

import { TypedBody, TypedParam, TypedRoute } from "@nestia/core";
import { Controller } from "@nestjs/common";

@Controller("/erpHrm/member/invitations")
export class ErphrmMemberInvitationsController {
  /**
   * Create an invitation to invite a prospective employee to join the organization.
   *
   * This endpoint allows users with `employee:manage` permission to send invitations to potential employees. The invitation is scoped to the currently selected organization context. When an invitation is sent to an existing user, an employee record is created immediately linking that user to the organization. When sent to a new user without an existing account, a pending invitation record is created that will be automatically accepted when the user registers with the invited email address.
   *
   * The invitation captures the email address of the person being invited, the organization reference from the current context, the invitation status (initially pending), and the timestamp of invitation creation. Optional pre-assignments include a role, department, and position that will be applied to the employee record upon acceptance.
   *
   * The system prevents duplicate invitations for the same email address within the same organization. If a pending invitation already exists for the email and organization combination, the request is rejected. Accepted invitations cannot be duplicated either.
   *
   * Security: Only authenticated users with `employee:manage` permission can create invitations. The invitation is tied to the user's current organization context and cannot be created for other organizations.
   *
   * @param connection
   * @param body Invitation creation payload containing the email address to invite and optional pre-assignments
   * @x-autobe-authorization-type null
   * @x-autobe-authorization-actor member
   * @x-autobe-specification Implement the invitation creation workflow for the erp_hrm_invitations table.
   *
   * 1. Authentication and Authorization:
   *    - Verify the requesting user is authenticated (has valid session)
   *    - Verify the user has `employee:manage` permission in the current organization context
   *    - Extract the organization ID from the current session context
   *
   * 2. Input Validation:
   *    - Validate email format is properly formatted (RFC 5322 compliant)
   *    - Validate email is not empty and does not exceed reasonable length (e.g., 255 characters)
   *    - If erpHrmRoleId is provided, verify the role exists and belongs to the current organization
   *    - If erpHrmDepartmentId is provided, verify the department exists and belongs to the current organization
   *    - Validate position length if provided (e.g., max 100 characters)
   *    - Validate note length if provided (e.g., max 500 characters)
   *
   * 3. Duplicate Check:
   *    - Query the database for existing invitation with the same erp_hrm_organization_id and email
   *    - Check for invitations with status 'pending' or 'accepted' (expired can be replaced)
   *    - If duplicate found with pending/accepted status, return error 409 Conflict
   *
   * 4. Invitation Creation:
   *    - Generate a secure random token for the invitation link
   *    - Create the invitation record with:
   *      - id: UUID generated server-side
   *      - erp_hrm_organization_id: from session context
   *      - erp_hrm_role_id: provided or null (will default to Employee role)
   *      - erp_hrm_department_id: provided or null
   *      - email: normalized (lowercase, trimmed)
   *      - status: 'pending'
   *      - token: generated secure token
   *      - position: provided or null
   *      - note: provided or null
   *      - accepted_at: null
   *      - expires_at: null or calculated (e.g., 7 days from now if expiration policy exists)
   *      - created_at: current timestamp
   *      - updated_at: current timestamp
   *      - deleted_at: null
   *
   * 5. Existing User Handling (within same transaction):
   *    - Check if a member with the given email exists in erp_hrm_members
   *    - If existing user found:
   *      - Create an employee record in erp_hrm_employees immediately
   *      - Use the invited role (or default Employee role if not specified)
   *      - Use the invited department if specified
   *      - Set the employee's status to 'active'
   *      - Update invitation status to 'accepted'
   *      - Set accepted_at to current timestamp
   *      - Return the invitation with employee creation confirmation
   *
   * 6. New User Handling:
   *    - No existing user found
   *    - Invitation remains with status 'pending'
   *    - Return the created pending invitation
   *
   * 7. Activity Logging:
   *    - Log the invitation creation in erp_hrm_activity_logs
   *    - Include: action 'invitation.create', target user email, inviter info
   *
   * 8. Response:
   *    - Return HTTP 201 Created with the created invitation entity
   *    - Include a flag or field indicating whether an employee was immediately created
   *    - For pending invitations, include the token for invitation link generation
   * @nestia Generated by Nestia - https://github.com/samchon/nestia
   */
  @TypedRoute.Post()
  public async create(
    @MemberAuth()
    member: MemberPayload,
    @TypedBody()
    body: IErpHrmInvitation.ICreate,
  ): Promise<IErpHrmInvitation> {
    try {
      return await postErpHrmMemberInvitations({
        member,
        body,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Retrieve a filtered and paginated list of invitations sent from the organization.
   *
   * This operation returns all invitations associated with the currently selected organization context, allowing users with appropriate permissions to browse, search, and filter through historical and pending invitations. The response is paginated to handle large result sets efficiently.
   *
   * The invitation entity stores email addresses of invited persons, their invitation status (pending, accepted, or expired), timestamps for creation and acceptance, and optional pre-assigned role and department information for streamlined onboarding.
   *
   * **Filtering Capabilities:**
   * - Filter by invitation status: pending, accepted, or expired
   * - Search by email address (partial matching supported)
   * - Sort by creation date or other sortable fields
   *
   * **Pagination:**
   * - Configurable page size with default limits
   * - Cursor or offset-based pagination for efficient traversal
   * - Total count information for UI display
   *
   * **Security:**
   * - Requires authenticated session with valid organization context
   * - Users must have employee:manage permission to view invitations
   * - Invitations are isolated per organization - users cannot access invitations from other organizations
   * - Soft-deleted invitations are excluded from results
   *
   * **Relationship to Database:**
   * - Queries erp_hrm_invitations table with erp_hrm_organization_id from session
   * - Joins with erp_hrm_roles for role name in summary (if requested)
   * - Joins with erp_hrm_departments for department name in summary (if requested)
   * - Results filtered by status and email search criteria
   * - Ordered by created_at descending by default
   *
   * @param connection
   * @param body Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering invitations
   * @x-autobe-authorization-type null
   * @x-autobe-authorization-actor member
   * @x-autobe-specification Query erp_hrm_invitations table filtered by erp_hrm_organization_id from session context.
   *
   * 1. Extract organization_id from authenticated user's session
   * 2. Build query: SELECT * FROM erp_hrm_invitations WHERE erp_hrm_organization_id = :orgId AND deleted_at IS NULL
   * 3. Apply filters from request body:
   *    - If status is provided, add: AND status = :status
   *    - If email is provided (search), add: AND email ILIKE '%' || :email || '%'
   * 4. Apply pagination:
   *    - OFFSET :page * :limit for offset pagination
   *    - Or cursor-based using id/created_at for large datasets
   * 5. Include total_count for pagination UI
   * 6. If includeRelations is true, JOIN with erp_hrm_roles and erp_hrm_departments
   * 7. Return IPageIErpHrmInvitation.ISummary with items array and pagination metadata
   *
   * Edge cases:
   * - Invalid status value: return 400 with validation error
   * - Page out of range: return empty items array with pagination metadata
   * - No invitations found: return empty items array, not 404
   * @nestia Generated by Nestia - https://github.com/samchon/nestia
   */
  @TypedRoute.Patch()
  public async index(
    @MemberAuth()
    member: MemberPayload,
    @TypedBody()
    body: IErpHrmInvitation.IRequest,
  ): Promise<IPageIErpHrmInvitation.ISummary> {
    try {
      return await patchErpHrmMemberInvitations({
        member,
        body,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Retrieve a single invitation by its unique identifier.
   *
   * This endpoint retrieves detailed information about a specific invitation within the authenticated user's organization context. The invitation must belong to the currently selected organization; invitations from other organizations are not accessible.
   *
   * The returned invitation object includes the invited email address, current status (pending, accepted, or expired), the timestamp when it was created, and optional fields such as the pre-assigned role, department, position, and a note from the organization. If the invitation has been accepted, the accepted_at timestamp is included.
   *
   * Security and Access Control:
   * - Only authenticated members with appropriate permissions can retrieve invitation details
   * - The invitation must belong to the currently selected organization context
   * - Users with `employee:manage` permission can view all invitations in their organization
   * - Invitations that have been soft-deleted (deleted_at is not null) are not returned
   *
   * Related Database Entities:
   * - The invitation references erp_hrm_organizations for the owning organization
   * - Optionally references erp_hrm_roles for pre-assigned role
   * - Optionally references erp_hrm_departments for pre-assigned department
   *
   * Expected Response:
   * - 200 OK with full invitation details
   * - 404 Not Found if invitation does not exist or does not belong to the current organization
   *
   * @param connection
   * @param invitationId Unique identifier of the invitation to retrieve
   * @x-autobe-authorization-type null
   * @x-autobe-authorization-actor member
   * @x-autobe-specification Query the erp_hrm_invitations table by invitation ID.
   *
   * 1. Extract invitationId from path parameters (must be valid UUID format)
   * 2. Validate that the invitation exists and belongs to the authenticated user's current organization context
   * 3. Ensure the invitation has not been soft-deleted (deleted_at must be null)
   * 4. Join with erp_hrm_organizations to verify organization ownership
   * 5. Optionally join with erp_hrm_roles and erp_hrm_departments to include pre-assigned values in response
   * 6. Return 404 error if invitation is not found or belongs to a different organization
   * 7. Return the full invitation record including all fields: id, erp_hrm_organization_id, erp_hrm_role_id, erp_hrm_department_id, email, status, token, position, note, accepted_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at
   * @nestia Generated by Nestia - https://github.com/samchon/nestia
   */
  @TypedRoute.Get(":invitationId")
  public async at(
    @MemberAuth()
    member: MemberPayload,
    @TypedParam("invitationId")
    invitationId: string & tags.Format<"uuid">,
  ): Promise<IErpHrmInvitation> {
    try {
      return await getErpHrmMemberInvitationsInvitationId({
        member,
        invitationId,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.log(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Update an existing invitation within the current organization context.
   *
   * This operation allows users with `employee:manage` permission to modify invitation properties before the invitee accepts. The invitation must be in 'pending' status to be updated - accepted or expired invitations cannot be modified through this endpoint.
   *
   * The operation supports updating pre-assigned role and department for streamlined onboarding, modifying the invitation note or position, and extending the expiration date (effectively resending the invitation). When the expiration date is updated, the invitation link remains valid with the new timeframe.
   *
   * The invitation is scoped to the currently selected organization in the session context. All updates are validated against the organization ownership - invitations cannot be transferred between organizations.
   *
   * **Security**: Requires `employee:manage` permission. Only invitations belonging to the current organization can be updated.
   *
   * **Validation Rules**:
   * - Invitation must exist and not be soft-deleted
   * - Invitation must be in 'pending' status
   * - Invitation must belong to the current organization context
   * - Role assignment (if provided) must reference an existing role within the organization
   * - Department assignment (if provided) must reference an existing department within the organization
   * - Email format validation applies if email is modified
   *
   * **Status Transition**: The status remains 'pending' after update unless explicitly transitioned through cancellation flow (handled separately).
   *
